history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 31‑year‑old woman with longstanding pulmonary emphysema who reports chronic dyspnea and intermittent fatigue. She has documented obstructive sleep apnea and a generic sleep disorder, both contributing to nocturnal hypoxia. Laboratory data reveal prediabetes (A1c 6.2%) and anemia of unclear etiology, for which she receives vitamin B12 injections. Over the past decade she has had relatively stable outpatient follow‑up with few acute visits, suggesting chronic disease stability but with several gaps in preventive and therapeutic management.
